summary_notes: Mid-market e-commerce product team building a post-purchase support agent focused on returns + shipping. Primary ask: streaming chat with tool-calling (order lookup, refund initiation, shipping labels). Very latency sensitive: p95 target <=250ms for token streaming in normal ops, <350ms under typical peak; currently seeing p95 ~800ms under synthetic 3x load. Interested in starting on Hosted API for quick POC, then moving to Dedicated/reserved capacity for predictable peak handling and cost control. Seasonality: high returns volume post-holiday (Nov-Dec) and promotional spikes, needs burst capacity. Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for keys, EU data residency for EU customers. Integration: Zendesk + Shopify + internal order-service; tool-calling must support secure callbacks and per-request auth.
